title: Nounocle
tagline: AI powered Nouns Glasses  using galadriel and Tiny ML. and a blockchain messaging system
description: leveraging galadriel agents and cross chain messaging we are able to connect hardware glasses to a secure blockchain backed LLM that can be used with multiple agents to provide an AI smart glasses experience akin to ray ban smart glasses. without geofencing we can have distributed ai agents on wearable devices
how_its_made:
This project uses esp32s, custom firmware, galadriel agents, cross chain messaging and payment bridging for network use. native nounocle token is $noun so to pay for inference you can automatically bridge your token to nouns and pay for monthly inference on the network.
